name: player_build_ai_peer_rings_by_ai_net_id
description: AINet::BuildAiPeerRingsByAiNetId links active save states with matching aiNetId into circular peer rings, leaving inactive, different-id, or already-linked candidates unchanged.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; final byte matching should be handled in the coherent ai_net.cpp source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x403750 validates the global save-state list walk, nested candidate walk from each saveState->next, aiNetId comparison at playerState+0xf70, inactive lifecycle skip for state 4, already-linked ring skip when candidate->aiPeerRingNext != candidate, and insertion of eligible candidates after the current save state.

The native smoke verifies same-id active candidates are linked into the first matching circular peer ring, inactive and different-id candidates remain self-linked, and a second invocation is stable because already-linked candidates are skipped.
